en.headline: Observatory cancels Strong Monsoon Signal after afternoon winds ease
en.dek: The signal, issued at 09:45 HKT, was cancelled at 14:15 as the northeast monsoon weakened and mean winds dropped below the threshold.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled the Strong Monsoon Signal at 2:15 p.m. on Tuesday after the northeast monsoon affecting the coast eased.
The signal had been in force since 9:45 a.m., when the Observatory warned of northerly winds with mean speeds exceeding 40 kilometres per hour and occasional gale-force gusts.
With the cancellation, the public is no longer advised to take special precautions against strong gusty winds, though residual rough conditions may linger over offshore waters.
The Observatory said the monsoon is expected to continue influencing the region with cooler weather in the coming days.

zh.headline: 天文台取消強烈季候風信號 下午風勢減弱
zh.dek: 信號於上午9時45分發出，至下午2時15分取消，東北季候風減弱後平均風速已低於發出門檻。
body: 香港天文台於周二下午2時15分取消強烈季候風信號，指影響沿岸的東北季候風已減弱。
信號自上午9時45分起生效，當時天文台警告偏北強風，平均風速每小時超過40公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。
取消後，市民無需再特別防範強陣風，但離岸海域或仍有殘餘大浪。
天文台表示，季候風將繼續影響本港，未來數日天氣轉涼。
